description: Client code for testing and interacting with the git fsmonitor--daemon, including sending queries, flush commands, and stress testing via threading.

methods.name: get_token_from_index
methods.description: Reads the last token from the FSMonitor Index Extension in the git index.

methods.name: do_send_query
methods.description: Sends a query to the fsmonitor daemon with a specified token.

methods.name: do_send_flush
methods.description: Sends a flush command to the fsmonitor daemon to clear its cache.

methods.name: hammer_thread_proc
methods.description: Thread procedure to repeatedly send queries to the daemon for stress testing.

methods.name: do_hammer
methods.description: Starts multiple threads to send a series of requests to the daemon for load testing.

methods.name: cmd__fsmonitor_client
methods.description: Main command handler for the fsmonitor client subcommands: query, flush, hammer.
